name: focus-pull-headline
title: Focus Pull Headline
description: A rack focus between two lines of text. A small context line starts sharp while the headline is a heavy blur; the focus pulls, the headline resolves to sharp and the context line drifts out of focus and dims. A thin accent line draws under the headline once it lands. Not a scene transition (see focus-pull) and not a single-text reveal (see focus-blur-resolve).
useWhen: An opening line where a question or setup gives way to the answer: the context line first, then the headline.
A calm, premium headline for a product or a shop.
avoidWhen: A fast punchy hook: use beat-title-cards.
Changing between two scenes: use focus-pull.
author: Mosio
